piezas.titulo: Word reading: Humour, idioms and cultural references
texto: Reading and spelling of lexicographic and rhetorical terms of humour and idioms: «สำนวน» combines «สำ» (rising tone with the vowel อำ) and «นวน» (mid tone with น in the แม่กน group). «มุก» is a colloquial and learned word with the mid consonant ม and ก in the แม่กก group (high tone; a common spelling in theatre and media discourse). «ล้อเล่น» has «ล้อ» (high tone with the mark ้ over ล) and «เล่น» (falling tone with the mark ่ over ล). «บริบท» has three learned syllables: «บ» (bɔɔ, mid tone), «ริ» (rí, high tone) and «บท» (bòt, low-class consonant บ with ท in the แม่กด group sounding as [t], low tone).
